sources.title: Nomic Embed: Training a Reproducible Long Context Text Embedder
sources.snippet: Abstract This technical report describes the training of nomic-embed-text-v1, the first fully reproducible, open-source, open-weights, open-data, 8192 context length English text embedding model that outperforms both OpenAI Ada-002 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-small on the short-context MTEB benchmark and the long context LoCo benchmark.
